name: shiu-original-JON-100Hz-pilot
condition: JON CE + F + D_m input at 100 Hz
stimulus_generator: numpy.default_rng PCG64; Bernoulli(rate*dt), N=1 per cell per tick
hypothesis: JON drive recruits the named descending readouts relative to zero input.
evaluation: Compare every native spike to Brian2 and report both readouts. Neural response is not evidence of physically executed grooming.
failure: Any hidden input, pruned edge, graph mismatch, numerical divergence or absent predicted response must be reported.
caveat: 100 Hz belongs to the original input sweep; one paired seed is a pilot, not reproduction of the full published sweep.
